sources.title: Inside GPT-5.6 Sol and the Dawn of True Agentic Reasoning
sources.snippet: The most heavily scrutinized benchmark for any modern AI model is its ability to write and debug code. GPT-5.6 Sol establishes an entirely new high-water mark on the SWE-bench evaluation which measures a model's ability to resolve real-world issues pulled directly from production GitHub repositories.
